takeaway: IMN Monday regional keeps a typical rainy-season ITCZ day for Pacífico Norte: isolated afternoon storms and possible coastal rains tonight, with Nicoya heat near 32°C. No tropical cyclone near Costa Rica — TS Polo (ex-EP99) and TS Odalys stay well offshore Mexico/west EPAC. Ensemble means still favor Pacific SW moisture and flanking EPAC lows mid–late week; NHC marine now flags a monsoon low building early Friday between Costa Rica and Guatemala. Gyre watch remains elevated, not established.

periods.label: Days 1–3 (Mon–Wed)
periods.pattern: Today (IMN Pacífico Norte, valid Mon 21 Sep): dawn partial–mostly cloudy with rains south of the region; morning partly cloudy; afternoon partly cloudy with isolated storms; evening partial–mostly cloudy with possible coastal rains. General commentary: unstable moist ITCZ over the country — morning maritime storms that can brush coasts, afternoon Pacific-side storms, night coastal Pacific rains. Nicoya max ~32.3°C / min ~23.3°C (Liberia ~35.5°C). Weekly text (17–23 Sep) still carries OT#45 into early week — treat the daily regional as authoritative for today. GFS 06Z / GEFS mean 06Z / EPS mean 00Z 24-h maps keep Nicoya mostly light–moderate (~0.1–0.75 in / 24 h) through Tue morning. GEFS mean f024 shows light W–SW 850 flow with a ~1003 hPa L south of CR/Panama — moist ITCZ, not a closed land gyre. Papagayo light (NHC).
periods.implications: Mornings remain the better outdoor window; plan around this afternoon–evening convective window on the Pacific side. Heat still warm inland (Liberia mid-30s).
periods.confidence: High for no nearby TC and a continued shower/storm day under ITCZ influence (IMN + NHC). Moderate on exact Nosara storm timing/amounts (IMN wetter language vs light–moderate model maps).

periods.label: Days 4–7 (Thu–Sun)
periods.pattern: Thu (~24 Sep): GEFS mean 06Z f072 shows SW 850 flow over Nicoya and a ~1003 hPa L south of CR/Panama; EPS mean 00Z f072 has a ~997 hPa EPAC L with SW onshore flow; GFS deterministic 06Z f072 is locally wetter over Nicoya (~0.75–1.25 in / 24 h) while GEFS mean stays ~0.1–0.75 in. By ~Fri–Sat 25–26 (f120), GEFS/EPS/AIFS-ENS means keep flanking EPAC lows (~999–1003 hPa) and W–SW 850 flow into Nicoya; 24-h means diverge (GEFS light ~0.05–0.2 in, EPS ~0.3–0.5 in, AIFS-ENS wetter ~0.75–1.5 in) — treat as moisture signal, not a locked temporales. NHC OFFPZ8 synopsis: winds/seas build early Fri as a low develops within the monsoon between Costa Rica and Guatemala. Not locked as a multi-day temporal or closed Central American gyre.
periods.implications: Keep late-day plans flexible mid-to-late week; treat any wetter stretch as afternoon cells plus possible SW moisture. Marine: Papagayo turns more S/SW with seas building toward Fri night (NHC).
periods.confidence: Moderate for continued shower chances and a moister Pacific-side flow signal mid–late week; low–moderate for sustained temporales or a closed Central American gyre.

periods.label: Days 8–15
periods.pattern: IMN sub-seasonal (21 Sep–18 Oct) still keeps Pacífico Norte below normal (weekly Pac Norte roughly 5–90 mm for 21–27 Sep) with stronger-than-usual trades limiting Pacific-side rain. CPC GTH text (updated 15 Sep; valid 23 Sep–6 Oct) favors below-average Caribbean rainfall weeks 2–3; EPAC genesis risk is coastal Mexico / open EPAC, not CR. GEFS mean into ~28 Sep keeps Nicoya light–moderate (~0.5–0.75 in / 24 h at f168) without a local extreme bullseye. Single deterministic frames can still show a wetter day later — treat as scenario only.
periods.implications: No official signal for a prolonged flood-season spike on the Nicoya Pacific side; short heavy cells remain possible.
periods.confidence: Moderate for below-normal / no major local TC theme; low for day-by-day rain.

gyreWatch.possibleTiming: Roughly mid–late week (~Thu–Sat 24–27 Sep), with NHC marine pointing to a monsoon low early Fri between CR and Guatemala if flanking EPAC lows and sustained Pacific SW low-level flow persist
gyreWatch.supporting: GEFS mean 06Z f072–f120 shows ~1003 hPa EPAC L and SW 850 flow over Nicoya; EPS mean 00Z f072–f120 has ~997–999 hPa EPAC L with SW onshore flow; AIFS-ENS 00Z f120 has ~1003 hPa EPAC L and SW Pacific-side flow; GFS det 06Z f072 also carries onshore SW 850 with deep EPAC lows. NHC OFFPZ8 explicitly builds winds/seas Fri as a monsoon low develops CR–Guatemala. Short-term IMN ITCZ language supports a wet Pacific start to the week.
gyreWatch.conflicting: Ensemble means do not show a closed gyre centered over Central America — pattern is flanking EPAC lows / monsoon trough plus SW moisture. Deep GFS/ECMWF lows near Mexico are TC-type features (Polo environment), not a CR gyre. Ensemble-mean Nicoya precip stays mostly light–moderate with model spread by Sat. NHC has no disturbance near Costa Rica (TS Polo and TS Odalys are well west/NW of CR; Tehuantepec area is Mexico-parallel). IMN sub-seasonal still favors Pacific rainfall deficit. Ensemble means only — no member-count probabilities.

whatChanged: Latest IMN aviso is now Sunday’s ITCZ shower/storm notice (Sun 20 Sep 10:30 a.m.); OT#45 is further in the rear-view. EP99 is named Tropical Storm Polo (still far from CR); NHC adds a separate Tehuantepec genesis area (~40% in 7 days). Biggest guidance shift: NHC OFFPZ8 now explicitly cites a monsoon low early Friday CR–Guatemala with building S winds/seas — reinforcing the elevated mid–late-week SW-moisture watch. Wed no longer stands out as clearly quieter than Thu in today’s GEFS/EPS means (SW signal already by ~Thu 24). Nicoya heat still ~32°C; Papagayo remains light early week then turns SW/S.
practical: Best apparent outdoor windows: mornings Mon–Wed before convective peaks. Worth planning around: afternoon–evening isolated storms today under ITCZ (IMN), warm Guanacaste inland heat (Liberia ~35°C; Nicoya ~32°C), and Papagayo W–NW 10–15 kt today with seas ~3–5 ft turning SW midweek and S 15–25 kt with seas building Fri (NHC OFFPZ8 PMZ113). Latest listed IMN aviso is Sun 20 Sep — no new Monday aviso on the list collected this morning.
